scientific_integrity: The displayed theorem has an analytical proof and is accompanied by independent finite numerical checks that are not presented as a proof of the infinite-family claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact weighted DCT-I finite-dimensional sampling only; no claims for unweighted observations, rounded arithmetic, unknown erasures or other norms. Historical priority has not been independently established; an earlier DCT erasure article could not be examined in full.
title: Sharp quintic two-erasure stability for Chebyshev–Lobatto cosine sampling
